title: saccoloma henriettae

This medicinal mushroom is rich in bioactive constituents, including polysaccharides, glycoproteins, and other compounds that have been found to have potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Saccoloma henriettae include stimulating the growth of nerve cells, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system, due to its bioactive constituents such as β-glucans and other polysaccharides.
